package consumer

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/webroute"
)

func (svc *Service) RegisterRoutes(reg webroute.Registerer) error {
	if err := reg.Register("POST", "/broken/{id", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var request Request
		if !webroute.DecodeJSON(w, r, &request) {
			return
		}
		response, err := handleJSON(r.Context(), svc, request)
		webroute.WriteResult(w, http.StatusOK, response, err)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := reg.Register("GET", "/raw", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		request, ok := webroute.ReadRaw(w, r)
		if !ok {
			return
		}
		response, err := handleRaw(r.Context(), svc, request)
		webroute.WriteResult(w, http.StatusOK, response, err)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func RegisterRoutes(reg webroute.Registerer, svc *Service) error {
	return svc.RegisterRoutes(reg)
}
